title: Clyde River in a blizzard, at night, full, at a phone's width
description: A blizzard: ECCC's wind chill leads (Feels like −21°, Air −9° under it), the chart's air and wind-chill lines with the gap filled, an 80 % chance as bars for the hours ECCC gave it, night on both sides of a 1 h 38 min day, the footer's daylight line, minus signs.
